premise: Lola wants a tall tower and Nico a big wall; building alone, her tower slumps and his wall has nothing to guard, so they build a castle together.
inspiration: Aesop's bundle of sticks (together is stronger) made into a sand castle: each half is silly alone, and the two ideas make one castle.
lesson: Two ideas can make one better thing.

en-US.title: Two Towers
en-US.text: {bucket:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico were building something big. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] "Let's make a tower, as tall as the lighthouse!" {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] "No, a wall! A great big wall!" {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Tower. Wall. Tower. WALL. [short pause] So they each built alone. {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola filled the bucket and piled up a tower… tall, taller… {sfx:crumble} plop. It slumped over. {girl:shake} Nico patted out a long wall… but it had nothing to guard. Hmm. They looked at each other. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} "What if… a tower, with a wall around it?" {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] "And a door! And a flag!" {surfer:go to girl} So they built it together. {girl:live play-sand} Pat, pat, scoop. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} And there it stood, their sand castle, {castle:sparkle} three towers tall. {castle:live flag} Its little red flag waved. {girl:live kite} Lola flew her kite high above it, {surfer:hop x2} and Nico cheered. [happily] One castle, three towers, and two builders.

es-ES.title: Dos torres
es-ES.text: {bucket:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico estaban construyendo algo grande. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Hagamos una torre altísima, como el faro!» {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] «¡No, una muralla! ¡Una muralla enorme!» {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Torre. Muralla. Torre. MURALLA. [short pause] Así que cada uno construyó solo. {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola llenó el cubo y levantó una torre… alta, más alta… {sfx:crumble} plof. Se desplomó. {girl:shake} Nico alisó una muralla larga… pero no tenía nada que proteger. Mmm. Se miraron. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} «¿Y si… hacemos una torre, con una muralla alrededor?» {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Y una puerta! ¡Y una bandera!» {surfer:go to girl} Así que lo hicieron juntos. {girl:live play-sand} Plas, plas, zas. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} Y allí estaba su castillo de arena, {castle:sparkle} con tres torres. {castle:live flag} Su banderita roja ondeaba. {girl:live kite} Lola hizo volar su cometa por encima, {surfer:hop x2} y Nico aplaudió. [happily] Un castillo, tres torres y dos constructores.

ja-JP.title: タワーと かべ
ja-JP.text: {bucket:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}ローラと{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to girl}ニコは、なにか大きなものを、つくろうとしていました。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[excited]「とうだいくらい、たかーいタワーをつくろう！」 {surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「ちがうよ、かべだよ！でーっかいかべ！」 {girl:face sad}{surfer:face sad}タワー。かべ。タワー。かーべー！[short pause]そこで、ふたりは、べつべつにつくりました。{girl:go to bucket}{girl:live play-sand}ローラは、バケツで、タワーをつみあげます…たかく、もっとたかく…{sfx:crumble}どさっ。くたっと、たおれちゃった。{girl:shake}ニコは、ながーいかべを、ぺたぺた…でも、まもるものが、なんにもありません。うーん。ふたりは、かおを見あわせました。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}「じゃあ…タワーのまわりに、かべをつくったら？」 {surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「それと、ドアも！はたも！」 {surfer:go to girl}こんどは、ふたりいっしょに。{girl:live play-sand}ぺたぺた、ざっくん。{castle:enter}{surfer:go to castle}ほら、ふたりの砂のお城が、できました。{castle:sparkle}タワーが、みっつ！{castle:live flag}小さな赤いはたが、ぱたぱた。{girl:live kite}ローラはお城の上に、たこを高くあげて、{surfer:hop x2}ニコは、ばんざい！[happily]お城がひとつ、タワーがみっつ、だいくさんは、ふたり。

de-DE.title: Turm oder Mauer?
de-DE.text: {bucket:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola und {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico bauten etwas Großes. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] „Wir bauen einen Turm, so hoch wie der Leuchtturm!“ {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] „Nein, eine Mauer! Eine riesengroße Mauer!“ {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Turm. Mauer. Turm. MAUER. [short pause] Also baute jeder für sich allein. {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola füllte den Eimer und häufte einen Turm auf… hoch, höher… {sfx:crumble} plopp. Er sackte in sich zusammen. {girl:shake} Nico klopfte eine lange Mauer fest… aber die hatte gar nichts zu beschützen. Hmm. Die beiden sahen sich an. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} „Und wenn… wir einen Turm bauen, mit einer Mauer drumherum?“ {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] „Und mit einem Tor! Und einer Fahne!“ {surfer:go to girl} Also bauten sie zusammen. {girl:live play-sand} Klopf, klopf, schipp. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} Und da stand sie, ihre Sandburg, {castle:sparkle} drei Türme hoch. {castle:live flag} Ihr kleines rotes Fähnchen wehte. {girl:live kite} Lola ließ ihren Drachen hoch über der Burg tanzen, {surfer:hop x2} und Nico jubelte. [happily] Eine Burg, drei Türme und zwei Baumeister.

fr-FR.title: Deux tours
fr-FR.text: {bucket:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola et {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico construisaient quelque chose de grand. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] « On fait une tour, aussi haute que le phare ! » {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] « Non, un mur ! Un grand, grand mur ! » {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Une tour ! Un mur ! Une tour ! Un MUR ! [short pause] Alors chacun a construit de son côté. {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola a rempli le seau et elle a monté une tour… haute, plus haute… {sfx:crumble} flop. Elle s’est affaissée. {girl:shake} Nico, lui, a construit un long mur, tap, tap, tap… mais il n’avait rien à protéger. Hum… Ils se sont regardés. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} « Et si on faisait… une tour, avec un mur tout autour ? » {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] « Et une porte ! Et un drapeau ! » {surfer:go to girl} Alors ils se sont mis à construire ensemble. {girl:live play-sand} Tap, tap, hop. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} Et le voilà, leur château de sable, {castle:sparkle} avec ses trois tours. {castle:live flag} Son petit drapeau rouge flottait. {girl:live kite} Lola a fait voler son cerf-volant bien haut au-dessus du château, {surfer:hop x2} et Nico a poussé un grand hourra. [happily] Un château, trois tours, et deux bâtisseurs.

it-IT.title: Torre o muraglia?
it-IT.text: {bucket:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola e {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico stavano costruendo una cosa grande. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] «Facciamo una torre, alta come il faro!» {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] «No, una muraglia! Una muraglia gigante!» {girl:face sad} {surfer:face sad} Torre. Muraglia. Torre. MURAGLIA. [short pause] Così ognuno si è messo a costruire da solo. {girl:go to bucket} {girl:live play-sand} Lola ha riempito il secchiello e ha tirato su una torre… alta, più alta… {sfx:crumble} plof. È crollata giù. {girl:shake} Nico ha battuto una muraglia lunga lunga… ma non aveva niente da proteggere. Mmm. Si sono guardati. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} «E se… facessimo una torre, con la muraglia tutta intorno?» {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «E una porta! E una bandiera!» {surfer:go to girl} Così si sono messi a costruire insieme. {girl:live play-sand} Pam, pam, paletta. {castle:enter} {surfer:go to castle} Ed ecco lì il loro castello di sabbia, {castle:sparkle} con tre torri. {castle:live flag} La sua bandierina rossa sventolava. {girl:live kite} Lola ci ha fatto volare sopra l'aquilone, {surfer:hop x2} e Nico esultava. [happily] Un castello, tre torri e due costruttori.

zh-TW.title: 高塔和城牆
zh-TW.text: {bucket:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}蘿拉和{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to girl}尼可想蓋一個好大好大的東西。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[excited]「我們來蓋一座塔，跟燈塔一樣高！」 {surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「不要，蓋城牆！一道超級大的城牆！」 {girl:face sad}{surfer:face sad}高塔。城牆。高塔。城——牆！[short pause]於是，他們各蓋各的。{girl:go to bucket}{girl:live play-sand}蘿拉裝滿小桶，堆起一座塔……高高的，更高了……{sfx:crumble}噗——塔歪了，塌下來了。{girl:shake}尼可拍出一道長長的城牆……可是牆裡面什麼也沒有，要保護誰呢？嗯……他們你看我，我看你。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}「要不要……蓋一座塔，外面再圍一圈城牆？」 {surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「還要有門！還要插旗子！」 {surfer:go to girl}於是，他們一起動手。{girl:live play-sand}拍拍、拍拍、挖一挖。{castle:enter}{surfer:go to castle}他們的沙堡蓋好了，{castle:sparkle}有三座高高的塔。{castle:live flag}小紅旗飄呀飄。{girl:live kite}蘿拉把風箏放得高高的，飛在沙堡上面，{surfer:hop x2}尼可開心地歡呼。[happily]一座沙堡，三座高塔，兩個小小建築師。

zh-HK.title: 兩座塔
zh-HK.text: {bucket:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}蘿拉和{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to girl}尼可想砌一樣很大的東西。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[excited]「我哋砌一座塔，同燈塔一樣咁高！」 {surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「唔好，砌一幅牆！一幅好大好大嘅牆！」 {girl:face sad}{surfer:face sad}要塔。要牆。要塔。要牆！[short pause]於是，他們各自砌各自的。{girl:go to bucket}{girl:live play-sand}蘿拉把紅色的水桶裝滿，堆起一座塔……高一點，再高一點……{sfx:crumble}噗。塔倒了下來。{girl:shake}尼可拍出一幅長長的牆……可是，牆裏面甚麼也沒有，守着誰呢？嗯……他們你望望我，我望望你。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}「不如……砌一座塔，再喺周圍砌一幅牆？」 {surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「仲要有門！仲要有旗！」 {surfer:go to girl}於是，他們一起砌。{girl:live play-sand}拍拍，拍拍，挖一下。{castle:enter}{surfer:go to castle}他們的沙堡終於砌好了，{castle:sparkle}有三座高高的塔。{castle:live flag}小紅旗迎風飄揚。{girl:live kite}蘿拉在沙堡上空放風箏，{surfer:hop x2}尼可大聲歡呼。[happily]一座沙堡，三座塔，還有兩個小小建築師。
